headline: Regional Music Teacher Mistakenly Hired as Lead Negotiator for Trade Pact After Humming Along to BRICS Gala Performance
body:
The Ministry of Commerce’s attempt to project 'cultural harmony' at the recent BRICS gala backfired spectacularly yesterday when a local piano instructor, Mr. Rajesh Sharma, was accidentally handed a portfolio for multilateral trade negotiations. Mr. Sharma, who was hired solely to provide background atmosphere during the dinner, was mistakenly ushered into the bilateral drafting room after he was caught harmonizing perfectly with a visiting head of state during a rendition of a classic Kishore Kumar track.

"The optics were just too perfect, and we assumed anyone who could sustain a vibrato that consistent must have a firm grasp on supply chain logistics and tariff reduction," said an undersecretary who requested anonymity while hiding in a supply closet. For three hours, Mr. Sharma successfully steered the summit’s agricultural committee by simply responding to every complex fiscal query with a confident, rhythmic hum and a gesture suggesting a shift in tempo, which delegates interpreted as a bold new strategy for grain export subsidies.

By the time the error was discovered, the trade delegation had already ratified a document that replaced standard interest rate terminology with musical notations like 'allegro' and 'diminuendo.' Mr. Sharma, who remains technically employed as a Senior Strategic Advisor until his invoice clears, spent his final hours in the role conducting the finance ministers like an orchestra, eventually securing a landmark deal that mandates all future diplomatic disputes be resolved via competitive karaoke.
caption: When the vibes are so good they accidentally trigger a global economic policy shift. The art of diplomacy has officially reached its peak. 🎙️📈 #BRICS #DiplomacyGoals #KishoreKumar #SummitVibes (satire)
